versions.content: The McSupportData element and its sub-structure shall be self- contained in the sense that there is no need to deliver the whole upstream descriptions of the ECU (including the ECU Extract, Software Component descriptions, Basic Soft- ware Module descriptions, ECU Configuration Values descriptions, Flat Map, etc.) in order to later generate the final "A2L"-file. This means that the RTE Generator has to copy the required information from the upstream descriptions into the McSupport- Data element.
